preprocessing: Pinned normalized mono16k feature extractor, attention mask enabled, one clip per forward pass
representation: Final contextual hidden state from the official full-precision Wav2Vec2ForCTC.wav2vec2 backbone in eval/inference mode; no CTC logits
targetPooling: Float64 mean accumulation over each original estimatedPoolingWindowFrames interval, cast to float32; no new alignment or changed windows
globalPooling: Float64 mean accumulation over all valid clip frames, cast to float32 and repeated for each target from that clip
coverage: Exactly every eligible row in the original feature rowIndices order; no filtering by ratings or alignment confidence
resume: Atomically publish a per-clip directory containing vectors.npz and its independently stored checksum/binding; validate every waveform and cached unit before reuse
limitations: The reused windows are forced canonical CTC occupancy plus fixed context, not measured phone boundaries.
Contextual hidden vectors retain information from the surrounding utterance.
This phonetic checkpoint is not interchangeable with the separately quantized ONNX alignment checkpoint; only their verified frame grids and fixed windows are shared.
Feature extraction supplies no new produced-phone labels or evidence of child speech-sound-disorder pronunciation correctness.
